interface.longDescription: Know what to ask next. Questions Worth Asking turns transcripts and meeting notes into ranked follow-up questions, exact supporting excerpts, and practical next steps. Compare related conversations, check earlier questions against later notes, and receive a Done and To-do checklist. When supported, get a client message with up to three questions and a separate internal draft. Supply one transcript and a clear review request to begin. Results and drafts appear in chat for you to review.

name: questions-worth-asking
description: Turn meeting notes into useful follow-up. Find missed questions, clarify what changed, and get a prioritized checklist with messages ready to use.
